responsibility: This file implements the generic widget layout framework underlying higher-level text-art diagrams. It provides the base widget conversion to canvas through a two-phase requested-size then allocated-rectangle protocol, and implements concrete reusable widgets including vertical box containers, plain text leaves, canvas wrappers, and simple single-child wrappers, establishing the hierarchical sizing and painting behavior that specialized widgets such as tree_widget build upon; it also contains framework selftests.
same_name_distinction: Implements the base widget-to-canvas pipeline and concrete widget behaviors such as vbox, text, and canvas widgets, along with framework selftests; unlike gcc/text-art/widget.h, it provides the operational layout and painting code.
